name: HighAmountGeoMismatch
label: REPLAY
scenario_text: Large transactions ($3000-$15000) across electronics, travel, crypto and peer transfers, with geo mismatches and moderate velocity across all hours.

attack_spec.name: HighAmountGeoMismatch
attack_spec.description: Large amounts across all merchants with geo mismatch, broad timing.

proposed_rule.rationale: Flags transactions with a geographic mismatch; this broad heuristic also affects legitimate travellers.
